title: The buffer region
caption: Titrating ethanoic acid with sodium hydroxide, the pH changes slowly over a wide range of added base: the solution contains both CH₃COOH and CH₃COO⁻ and resists change. This is the buffer region.
alt: Titration curve of 0.1 mol dm⁻³ ethanoic acid with 0.1 mol dm⁻³ sodium hydroxide, with the flat middle section shaded as the buffer region.
description: From about 2 to 22 cm³ the pH rises slowly from about 3.8 to 5.7: the buffer region.
A steep rise at 25 cm³, then levelling near pH 12.
